Title: No information security policy at ISMS level
Detail: Five approved topic-specific policies (CGI-POL-001 to -005) do not together satisfy clause 5.2 a) to d): none is appropriate to the purpose of the ISMS as a whole, provides a framework for setting objectives, or commits to continual improvement of the ISMS.
Management response / corrective action: Issue ISMS policy v1.0 meeting 5.2 a) to d); communicate and record acknowledgement.

Title: No risk acceptance criteria
Detail: The risk assessment method is documented and has operated twice, but no risk acceptance criteria or appetite exist. ACC-001 and ACC-V01 are in force and were therefore accepted against nothing.
Management response / corrective action: Approve risk acceptance criteria and appetite; re-ratify ACC-001 and ACC-V01 against them.

Title: SoA unapproved and residual risks unaccepted
Detail: The Statement of Applicability exists in draft, is complete and traceable, and has not been approved. No single consolidated risk treatment plan exists, and the risk owners have not accepted the residual risk on R-004, R-005 or VR-004.
Management response / corrective action: Approve SoA v1.0 and one consolidated RTP; obtain signed residual acceptance for the three High residual risks.

Title: No information security objectives
Detail: Fourteen key risk indicators exist. None carries a target, an owner, a timescale, a resourcing plan or an evaluation method, so none is an objective under 6.2 a) to j).
Management response / corrective action: Set ISMS objectives built on the 14 KRIs, with targets, owners, dates and an evaluation method.

Title: No competence requirements or evidence
Detail: No competence requirement is defined for any ISMS role and no documented evidence of competence is retained, as required by 7.2 d).
Management response / corrective action: Publish a role competence matrix; retain training, qualification and experience records.

Title: No internal audit programme and no internal audit performed
Detail: No audit programme exists (frequency, methods, responsibilities, criteria, scope, reporting) and no internal audit had been conducted before this engagement. This engagement does not close the requirement: the auditor prepared the Statement of Applicability under test.
Management response / corrective action: Approve an internal audit programme; commission an independent internal audit covering clauses 4-10 and the applicable controls.

Title: No management review has ever been held
Detail: Top management has never reviewed the ISMS. No agenda covers the 9.3.2 a) to g) inputs and no documented results or decisions exist.
Management response / corrective action: Hold management review #1 (Mar 2027) and #2 (Jun 2027) on an agenda covering 9.3.2 a) to g); minute the decisions.

Title: No nonconformity and corrective action process
Detail: No process or log exists for reacting to nonconformity, evaluating root cause, taking corrective action and reviewing its effectiveness. The exception register (EXC-001 to EXC-003) records approved deviations, which are a different object.
Management response / corrective action: Publish an NC and corrective action procedure; open the log with the 19 nonconformities in this report.

Title: Six of seventeen vendors process data with no DPA
Detail: Six vendors, 35% of the estate, process personal data on the organisation's behalf with no executed data processing agreement (KRI-V1 = 65%). Article 28(3) requires the agreement before processing begins and the processing is already happening, so the finding is independent of the SoA target date.
Management response / corrective action: Execute the six outstanding DPAs; build the GDPR Article 30 record of processing.

Title: Context and interested parties not documented
Detail: Context survives only as six risk-register assumptions. No interested-parties register exists and the climate-change relevance decision required by Amd 1:2024 has never been made.
Management response / corrective action: Approve a context, interested-parties and obligations register including the climate-change decision.

Title: ISMS scope drafted but not approved
Detail: The scope statement is complete and names interfaces and dependencies, but has not been approved by top management. This escalates to a major nonconformity if it is still unapproved at Stage 1.
Management response / corrective action: Approve the ISMS scope and boundary, including the AWS shared-responsibility statement.

Title: ISMS budget and time allocation unapproved
Detail: The USD 32,100 year-one budget is costed in CGI-RSK-001 and has not been approved, and no staff time is allocated to the ISMS.
Management response / corrective action: Approve the year-one budget and a named time allocation for ISMS work.

Title: No ISMS lead assigned and no RACI
Detail: Document owners exist, but nobody is assigned responsibility for ensuring the ISMS conforms to the standard or for reporting its performance to top management.
Management response / corrective action: Assign the ISMS lead in writing; publish the ISMS RACI across the SoA controls.

Title: ISMS risks, opportunities and change planning absent
Detail: Risks and opportunities for the ISMS itself have never been determined, and there is no rule for making changes to the ISMS in a planned manner.
Management response / corrective action: Record ISMS risks and opportunities; add a change-planning step to the ISMS procedure.

Title: Forty per cent of staff have not acknowledged the policy pack
Detail: CGI-TRK-001 shows 30 of 50 staff acknowledged. Approximately 20 people are bound by rules they have not read, and there is no recurring or role-based awareness programme.
Management response / corrective action: Drive acknowledgement to 100%; add a joiner acknowledgement gate; publish the annual curriculum.

Title: No documented-information control procedure or register
Detail: Individual documents carry control blocks. There is no procedure controlling creation, update, approval, distribution and retention, and no ISMS document register.
Management response / corrective action: Publish the document and record control procedure and the ISMS document register.

Title: Monitoring defined but not performed or reported
Detail: One of fourteen indicators has been measured once, as a by-product of the vendor programme. There is no monitoring programme, no analysis or evaluation step and no reporting route.
Management response / corrective action: Publish a quarterly monitoring report covering all 14 KRIs and the ISMS objectives.

Title: The ISMS does not yet operate as one system
Detail: Policies, register, gap assessment, vendor programme and SoA exist as separate deliverables with no process map linking them and no improvement loop fed by audits, indicators, incidents and exceptions.
Management response / corrective action: Publish an ISMS overview linking the clause 4-10 processes; open the improvement log.

Title: No ISMS communication plan
Detail: Policies are published and incident communications are defined, but nothing states what ISMS information is communicated, when, to whom, by whom and how.
Management response / corrective action: Publish the ISMS communication plan.

Title: Backups have never been restore-tested and no RTO or RPO is declared
Detail: AWS snapshots are configured. No restore has been performed, no recovery objectives are declared and the data export path has never been exercised. The SoA target date is 15 Dec 2026 and has not passed, so this is not yet a nonconformity. It becomes one on 16 Dec 2026.
Management response / corrective action: Approve CGI-POL-006 with RTO and RPO; evidence one restore to a clean environment (this is REC-03 and VRA-2026-001 C4 - run it once).

Title: The code path behind R-004 is unprotected
Detail: Ten controls tested in WP-22 are Not started: no secure development lifecycle, no coding standard, no mandatory peer review, no branch protection, no scanning, no penetration test, no environment separation, no change record. SoA target dates of 31 Mar 2027 have not passed; this becomes a nonconformity on 01 Apr 2027.
Management response / corrective action: Approve CGI-POL-007 and CGI-POL-008; enable branch protection requiring a second reviewer; start authenticated scanning.

Title: No cloud configuration baseline or drift detection
Detail: No baseline, no posture monitoring, no network security baseline and no documented segmentation. This is the documented reason R-005 remains High.
Management response / corrective action: Implement a CIS AWS Foundations baseline with posture monitoring (Project 7 delivers this).

Title: Awareness is induction-only
Detail: No recurring curriculum, no role-based training, no phishing simulation and no module on the CGI-POL-001 s4.5 AI-use rules that two shadow-IT tools already breach.
Management response / corrective action: Publish the annual curriculum with a phishing simulation and an AI-use module.

Title: No data loss prevention and no retention execution
Detail: Monitoring is metadata-only. Retention limits are designed in CGI-POL-004 and have never been executed, and no masking exists for logs or lower environments.
Management response / corrective action: Implement egress and DLP rules on Google Workspace and GitHub; execute the retention and deletion schedule.

Title: The joiner, mover and leaver population cannot be established
Detail: No joiner/leaver register and no archive of completed offboarding checklists exists, so the population for the four-hour revocation control could not be constructed or reconciled to an HR system of record. Five illustrative records in CGI-TRK-001 are not a population. Any future audit or SOC 2 examination will stop at the same point.
Management response / corrective action: Maintain a joiner/mover/leaver register reconciled monthly to the HR system; retain completed offboarding checklists.

Title: Four AWS complementary user entity controls are unaccepted
Detail: Organisation-wide CloudTrail with log file validation, MFA on the root account with restricted root use, least-privilege IAM with periodic review, and encryption management are all assumed by the provider's report and performed by nobody. If C1 is not met by 15 Dec 2026 the conditional pass lapses to Fail.
Management response / corrective action: Sign the CUEC acceptance record naming four owners; publish the shared-responsibility statement.

Title: This engagement is not independent
Detail: The auditor prepared CGI-ISO-001, including the Statement of Applicability tested in WP-06. Clause 9.2.2 c) requires auditor selection to ensure objectivity and impartiality. The limitation is declared in the audit plan and the affected workpapers are named.
Management response / corrective action: Appoint an auditor independent of the preparer for ISO-12; have the CEO review the WP-06 and WP-13 conclusions in the interim.

Title: A Tier 1 vendor is operating in FAIL status with no risk acceptance
Detail: Slack (CGI-VEN-004) scored 65% and failed on 15 Sep 2026. No CEO-approved, expiring risk acceptance on the ACC-001 pattern is on file. Re-assessment is due 15 Dec 2026.
Management response / corrective action: Remediate to a pass, or record a CEO-approved expiring acceptance, before Stage 1.

Title: No system description and no CUECs communicated to customers
Detail: Approximately 200 customers have never been told which controls they must perform for the platform's controls to work. Nothing in ISO-01 to ISO-17 or REC-01 to REC-18 creates this artefact, because ISO 27001 does not require it.
Management response / corrective action: Approve the system description and the CUEC schedule (CGI-SOC-001 Part 3); publish the CUECs in the customer agreement and the trust page.

Title: Fraud has never been considered as a risk category
Detail: CGI-RSK-001 covers phishing, ransomware, insider exfiltration, an authorisation flaw and cloud misconfiguration. It does not consider fraudulent reporting, misappropriation of assets or corruption. ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A has no fraud control, so no ISO action would ever surface this.
Management response / corrective action: Add a fraud consideration to the next CGI-RSK-001 review, covering incentives, pressures, opportunities and rationalisations.

Title: No service commitments are published
Detail: No SLA, uptime target or recovery commitment exists (assumption ISO-A04). The Availability category asks whether the system is available 'as committed'; with no commitment there is nothing to test against.
Management response / corrective action: Publish service commitments (uptime target, support response, recovery objectives) before any SOC 2 engagement includes Availability.

Title: Treatment actions are dated but unevidenced
Detail: Wave 1 of the treatment plan is not yet due at the audit date, so non-completion is not a nonconformity. No status tracker with evidence per action exists, which will make the position untestable when the dates do pass.
Management response / corrective action: Open a treatment status tracker carrying evidence per action.

Title: No compliance checking and no procedures beneath the policies
Detail: No compliance check against policy has ever run, and the runbooks the policies rely on do not exist. The planned runbook location shares AWS with the platform it would be used to recover.
Management response / corrective action: Add a quarterly compliance check to the management review agenda; write runbooks and store them outside the platform's own dependency.

Title: No privileged access review has ever been performed
Detail: CGI-POL-003 s4.7.1 mandates a quarterly privileged access review. Zero have been performed. Four quarterly records are needed before a Stage 2 audit and before any SOC 2 Type II period.
Management response / corrective action: Perform and retain the first quarterly privileged access review.

Title: Incident response has never been exercised
Detail: The plan is approved and complete on severity, roles and targets. No containment runbooks exist, no out-of-band channel is named, and no exercise has been held, so there is no evidence of operation at all.
Management response / corrective action: Run a SEV1 tabletop; record lessons learned; name an out-of-band channel.

Title: Segregation of duties on the code path
Detail: Engineers can commit directly to production with no second person. This is the duty conflict behind R-004 and it is also the CC8.1 point of focus an examiner would test first.
Management response / corrective action: Publish a segregation-of-duties matrix; require a second reviewer in branch protection.

Title: No asset inventory and no endpoint register
Detail: The 17-row vendor inventory is an input to an asset inventory and is frequently mistaken for one. Fifty BYOD endpoints are unregistered and unmanaged, and the four classification tiers have been applied to zero assets.
Management response / corrective action: Build the asset and SaaS inventory with an owner and a classification per asset; register the 50 endpoints.
